summary: Revised the interface probe to close the limitation its account states: the missing StoreConfiguration callback had only been measured after an AddVoter that moved an existing voter's address. The revision keeps that case and the ConfigurationStore-only control and adds two dual-interface cases whose single configuration change is produced by a different command — AddNonvoter for a fresh server, and RemoveServer of a follower — recording the trigger in both events so each case is separately identifiable, with one new source range for the command interpretation. Four comparisons ask the documented callback to arrive in each case; a construction run suggests the answer is the same zero for all three commands while the control stays at six, but the retained execution decides it and nothing is claimed from the construction run. This is the last measurement I have queued: with about twenty-five minutes left, the four asserted findings and two refuted leads all carry accounts, receipts and recorded counterevidence, and the only outstanding item is interpreting this receipt when it arrives.
